messages:
Maya (Marketing): Heads-up: want to go live with the product announcement Monday 08:30 PT. Need: final one-line lead, two-line changelog, canonical docs URL (stable), and canary timing. Also need webinar reg link for CTA. Can eng + docs confirm? :mega:
Rafael (Eng): We can ship at 08:30 PT. Proposed rollout: 1% canary for 30m, 10% for 20m, then 100% if metrics stable. No infra changes during canary. Will keep feature-flag off for the new routing by default.
Maya (Marketing): Great. Nina, can you share the docs slug for the post? Also please paste a copy-ready changelog line.
Nina (Docs): Draft canonical: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/187450-stable — I'll finalize and lock at 07:45 PT. Changelog suggestion: "Latency improvements for long-context chat (median down ~20%) and prefix KV-cache to cut repeated-prompt token usage." Use that exact phrasing if helpful.
lee_s: Webinar confirmed at 10:00 PT same day. Reg link: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/187450-reg. Use iframe embed: https://events.redwood.ai/embed/187450.
Jordan (Ops): Inbound lead flow: post to https://hooks.redwood.ai/marketing-leads, header x-source:marketing. SFDC campaign mapped to ID "Launch_Mon_187450". I've tested the endpoint.
Maya (Marketing): Need example lead payload for the comms and a sample UTM scheme for blog vs newsletter.
Jordan (Ops): Payload example (POST /lead):
```json
{
  "email": "alex@test.com",
  "name": "Alex Test",
  "company": "ExampleCorp",
  "utm_source": "blog",
  "utm_campaign": "launch_mon_q2",
  "product_tag": "rwd-v2-std"
}
```
Jordan (Ops): Endpoint returned 200 OK in tests. Will forward into SFDC campaign Launch_Mon_187450.
Rafael (Eng): Deploy PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4152 90% tests passed. Main toggle name: routing.experimental_quant. We'll keep it disabled initially. If we see p95 latency decrease and stable errors, we'll consider enabling in second-phase rollout.
Maya (Marketing): Good. For copy we need: 1) headline sentence (short), 2) 2-line changelog bullet (use Nina's or edit), 3) canonical docs link, 4) webinar CTA link (lee_s please confirm embed works).
lee_s: Embed tested on site, works. Use the reg link above. Also happy to provide a short blurb for the webinar: "Live demo + deep-dive on perf improvements and cost tradeoffs."
Rafael (Eng): Monitoring thresholds: abort if p95 > 300ms for more than 5m OR error-rate > 1% for 3m OR token-cost delta > +15% sustained for 10m. Rollback instructions are in PR description.
Maya (Marketing): Who owns the embargo/freeze window? We want content freeze 20m before publish.
Nina (Docs): I'll lock the page at 08:10 PT and set edit permissions. A small doc patch is OK but please ping me.
Rafael (Eng): Release owner is me. No other deploys during canary. I'll post the canary start timestamp here once deployed.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy tid-2026-05-10-2101 queued for canary pool.
Rafael (Eng): Canary start: 1874503800 (08:30:00 PT). Deploy TID tid-2026-05-10-2101. On-call: Rafael + lee_s.
deploy-bot: deploy tid-2026-05-10-2101 completed to canary (1%) 9dlogs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/2101
Maya (Marketing): Final changelog copy-ready (from Nina): "Latency: ~20% lower median for long-context chat; added prefix KV-cache to reduce token cost for repeated prompts. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/187450-stable"
Jordan (Ops): UTM samples: blog -> utm_source=blog&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch_mon_q2; newsletter -> utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch_mon_q2. Add &product_tag=rwd-v2-std.
Maya (Marketing): Perfect. I'll schedule the CMS post at 08:30 PT with the webinar CTA at top and include the lead webhook for the CTA form. Will post final copy here at 08:15 PT for sign-off.
Rafael (Eng): We'll monitor p50/p95, errors, and cost. If rollback needed, I'll trigger rollback job in CI and notify channel.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks all 94 locking thread. Final sign-off pending at 08:15 PT."
